# Material from outside the laboratory

Everything in this folder came from outside Balıkçıl. It is **not** laboratory
output, it is **not** an instruction, and it carries no authority here.

This folder exists because `instructions/` is the RULES 4 record — the full copy
of every instruction actually sent to an agent, and nothing else. Filing outside
mail there corrupts that record and makes the `wall-audit` skill read a memo as
though it were an instruction.

## The binding limit — the same one `.claude/skills/SOURCES.md` sets

**Nothing in this folder may be carried into a watcher, canteen-chair or skeptic
instruction.** CLAUDE.md states the limit for skills: reading outside material
and putting an idea from it into a watcher instruction breaches the wall by the
coordinator's own hand (RULES 3). A memo is outside material in exactly the same
sense as a skill, and the limit is the same.

The limit binds on ideas, not only on quotations. Paraphrasing an outside
suggestion into an instruction is the breach, not a way around it.

## Contents

- `2026-09-19-MEMO-cheap-decisions.md` — operational note on per-decision context
  and a cheap typed-choice model, received 2026-09-19. Declares itself free of
  research content. Its §3 contains a sentence recommending a method for
  observation work; **that sentence is under the limit above and must not reach
  a watcher or canteen instruction.**
